differences: The medium route inspector is intentionally a side sheet rather than the persistent third pane shown at wide width.
The compact window removes the policy list while editing a group instead of shrinking all three panes.
The prototype uses the system UI font stack rather than a branded downloadable typeface.
suggestions: Keep the inspector transition transform-only so the preview remains smooth.
Preserve the copper route line as the only strong non-semantic accent.
Carry the same single-task compact behavior and accessible control names into the GPUI view model.
next_actions: Document tokens, components, responsive states, and GPUI event flow.
reasoning: The prototype clearly expresses the selected Signal Patch Bay world while retaining familiar desktop list-detail behavior. Wide, medium, compact, light, and dark states remain legible, and the route chain stays the dominant product-specific interaction without turning ordinary controls into audio hardware. The final correction clearly labels the inspector as local rule prediction with demo data, reserves Mihomo /connections for observed truth, and restores the compact system-proxy control's accessible name.
